Every model is equipped with: Feeder mandibles.
• For each "Warriors" unit, one "Canoptek Scarabs" unit may be selected as Troops. Can't be a mandatory unit selection.
• The entire unit may receive one of the following upgrades per model:
Explosion: Scarab swarms may explodes like a vehicle with a 6" radius and with the "Scarab explosion" profile at the end of their movement (including Advance or Charge movement).
Bloodswarm Scarabs: Flayed Ones that Deep Strike within 6" do not scatter and may Charge normally.
Flensing Scarabs: Melee attacks gain the "Poison(2+)" and "Rending(5+)" abilities.
Frenzied Scarabs: The model gains +2 Initiative.
